en.name: Vegetable juice, shelf-stable
en.summary: An unopened can or carton of shelf-stable vegetable juice keeps 18 months from purchase in a cool, dark cupboard. Once you open it, it becomes a refrigerated food: vegetable juices are low in acid, so there is little in the liquid itself holding bacteria back.
en.pantry: 18 months from purchase while the pack is sealed, somewhere cool, dark and dry. The juice has been heat-processed and hermetically sealed, which is what gives it the shelf life — not anything in the vegetables. Store cans away from heat and damp, since a rusting seam is how a can fails, and never use one that is swollen, leaking or dented along a seam. Rotate your stock so the oldest cans get used first; these are exactly the sort of thing that hides at the back of a cupboard for years.
en.fridge: No refrigerated figure is published for an opened pack, but the rule is not in doubt: once the seal is broken, decant the juice into a clean bottle or jar, cap it, keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use it promptly. Vegetable juice is low in acid, which makes it a far better home for bacteria than a citrus juice once air has got in. Do not store it in the opened can; the juice will pick up a metallic taste.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for shelf-stable vegetable juice. Freezing works if you decant into a container with headspace, and the thawed juice is separated and best used in a soup, a stew or a bloody mary base rather than drunk straight. With an 18-month cupboard figure on the unopened can, freezing is really only useful for leftovers.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge and shake well. Use thawed juice in cooking rather than drinking it, and do not refreeze it.
spoilage: A swollen, bulging or leaking can — do not open it, and do not taste it.
Rust along a seam or a dent on the seam itself.
A fermented, yeasty or sour smell on opening.
Fizzing when poured, or a slimy texture.
tips: Rotate stock so the oldest can is used first.
Decant leftovers into a glass bottle; juice in an opened can tastes metallic.
Store cans somewhere dry — a damp cupboard rusts the seams.
Never use a can that is swollen or dented along a seam.

faq.q: How long does shelf-stable vegetable juice keep?
faq.a: 18 months from purchase, unopened, in a cool, dark, dry cupboard.

faq.q: Does opened vegetable juice need refrigerating?
faq.a: Yes. Vegetable juice is low in acid, so decant it, refrigerate it and use it promptly.

faq.q: Can you store juice in an opened can?
faq.a: It is better decanted into a glass bottle or jar. Juice left in an opened can picks up a metallic taste.

zh.name: 常溫蔬菜汁
zh.summary: 未開封的常溫蔬菜汁（罐裝或盒裝）自購買日起，放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃可放 18 個月。一旦開封，它就變成冷藏食品：蔬菜汁酸度低，液體本身幾乎沒有什麼能壓制細菌。
zh.pantry: 未開封、放在陰涼、避光、乾燥處，自購買日起 18 個月。這些果汁經過熱加工並且氣密封裝，給它保存期的是這個，不是蔬菜本身。罐頭請遠離熱源與潮濕，因為罐頭失效通常是從接縫生鏽開始的；鼓脹、滲漏，或接縫處被撞凹的，絕對不要使用。請先進先出——這類東西正是最容易在櫥櫃深處躲上好幾年的。
zh.fridge: 開封後沒有公布的冷藏數字，但規則毫無疑問：封口一破，就把果汁倒進乾淨的瓶子或罐子、蓋好、放 4 °C 以下，並且盡快用完。蔬菜汁酸度低，空氣一進去，它比柑橘類果汁更適合細菌生長。不要留在開過的罐頭裡，果汁會染上金屬味。
zh.freezer: 常溫蔬菜汁沒有公布的冷凍期限。倒進留有膨脹空間的容器就可以冷凍；解凍後會分層，拿去做湯、燉菜或血腥瑪麗的基底會比直接喝好。既然未開封在櫥櫃就有 18 個月，冷凍其實只對喝不完的剩量有用。
zh.thawing: 請放冷藏解凍並搖勻。解凍後拿去入菜而不是直接喝，也不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 罐身鼓脹、膨起或滲漏——不要開，也不要嚐。
接縫生鏽，或接縫處被撞凹。
打開時有發酵味、酵母味或酸味。
倒出來起泡，或質地變得黏滑。
tips: 先進先出，最舊的那罐先用。
喝不完的倒進玻璃瓶；留在開口罐頭裡會有金屬味。
罐頭放乾燥處——潮濕的櫥櫃會讓接縫生鏽。
鼓脹或接縫被撞凹的罐頭，絕對不要使用。

faq.q: 常溫蔬菜汁可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封放陰涼、避光、乾燥的櫥櫃，自購買日起 18 個月。

faq.q: 開封後的蔬菜汁要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 要。蔬菜汁酸度低，請倒出來、冷藏，並盡快用完。

faq.q: 可以直接存放在開過的罐頭裡嗎？
faq.a: 最好倒進玻璃瓶或罐子。留在開口罐頭裡的果汁會染上金屬味。
